title: Quicksviewer: An LMM with Early Video Compression using Annealed Gumbel-Softmax
abstract: arXiv:2504.15270v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) uniformly perceive video frames, creating computational inefficiency for videos with inherently varying temporal redundancy. This paper present **Quicksviewer**, an LMM with new perceiving paradigm that partitions a nonuniform redundant video into varying cubes using Gumbel Softmax, followed by a unified resampling for each cube to achieve efficient video understanding. We further propose a Gumbel-noise annealing strategy that enables stable end-to-end LMM training with the discrete cubing network. This simple and intuitive approach dynamically compress video online based on the momentum of frame differences, significantly reducing spatiotemporal complexity (overall 45$\times$ compression rate), while enabling efficient training with large receptive field. We train the model from a language backbone through three progressive stages, each incorporating lengthy videos on average of 420s/1fps thanks

translated_title: Quicksviewer：一种使用退火Gumbel-Softmax进行早期视频压缩的大型多模态模型
translated_abstract: 大型多模态模型（LMMs）统一地感知视频帧，这对于具有固有变化时间冗余的视频来说造成了计算效率低下的问题。本文提出了Quicksviewer，一种具有新感知范式的大型多模态模型，它使用Gumbel Softmax将非均匀冗余视频划分为不同大小的块，然后对每个块进行统一重采样，以实现高效的视频理解。我们进一步提出了一种Gumbel噪声退火策略，使离散分块网络能够稳定地进行端到端LMM训练。这种简单直观的方法基于帧差的动量在线动态压缩视频，显著降低了时空复杂度（总体45倍压缩率），同时通过大感受野实现高效训练。我们从语言骨干网络开始，通过三个渐进阶段训练模型，每个阶段都纳入平均时长420秒/1帧每秒的长视频……
tldr: Quicksviewer提出了一种基于退火Gumbel-Softmax的早期视频压缩方法，通过将非均匀冗余视频在线动态划分为不同大小的块并进行统一重采样，实现45倍压缩率的高效视频理解。
en_tdlr: Quicksviewer introduces an early video compression paradigm using annealed Gumbel-Softmax, which dynamically partitions nonuniform redundant videos into varying cubes with unified resampling online, achieving efficient video understanding with an overall 45× compression rate.
